description: Every finite-arity primitive-recursive function has a literal \(\Sigma_1\) arithmetic graph formula with exactly its standard input-output interpretation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.primitive_function_graph {n : ℕ} (f : (Fin n → ℕ) → ℕ)
  (hf : Primrec f) :
  ∃ G,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.BoundedSigmaOne G ∧
      ∀ (x : Fin n → ℕ) (y : ℕ),
        G.Realize (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend x y) ↔ f x = y
